texto_para_tela: CLOSED · AUG 2026 · CALTRANS | NOV 1, 2026: OPEN · ONE-WAY AT WORK ZONES · CALTRANS
nota: Caltrans 11/08: 'As of 2 pm Tuesday, August 11, a 10-mile stretch of Highway 1 is closed… from 2-miles north of Julia Pfeiffer Burns State Park (Post Mile 37.5) to Fernwood (Post Mile 47)' (McWay Falls, no parque, cai no Big Sur CCD). Caltrans 02/09: 'As of 6 am Thursday, September 3, the northern closure… will be lifted' e o fechamento do sul (Plaskett) 'remains in place from Pacific Valley at Post Mile 16 to Post Mile 0.0'. A estrada hoje, RELIDA: 'as of Wednesday, November 4th, 2026 at 01:16 PM', nenhum fechamento total em Big Sur; mão única em Mud Creek (dias úteis, 6:30–12:00, até 13/11), entre Point Sur e o norte de Big Sur (até 31/12) e na ponte de Rocky Creek (até 30/11). Igual à de 01/11. A tela pode levar NOV 1 (a leitura do dossiê) ou NOV 4, 2026 (a de hoje): as duas dizem o mesmo. A data da reabertura total depois do Plaskett não foi lida (só 'fully reopened', CAL FIRE).
conversoes: PM 47 − PM 37.5 = 9,5 mi (a Caltrans chama de '10-mile stretch')

citacoes_relidas.trecho: As of 2 pm Tuesday, August 11, a 10-mile stretch of Highway 1 is closed to support Timber Fire emergency response. Highway 1 is closed from 2-miles north of Julia Pfeiffer Burns State Park (Post Mile 37.5) to Fernwood (Post Mile 47)
As of 6 am Thursday, September 3, the northern closure of Highway 1 in support of Timber Fire operations will be lifted
The southern closure supporting Plaskett Fire emergency response along Highway 1 remains in place from Pacific Valley at Post Mile 16 to Post Mile 0.0 at the Monterey/San Luis Obispo County line
This highway information is the latest reported as of Wednesday, November 4th, 2026 at 01:16 PM
1-way controlled traffic at Mud Creek (Monterey Co) from 0630 hrs to 1200 hrs Monday thru Friday thru 11/13/26
This highway information is the latest reported as of Sunday, November 1st, 2026 at 10:40 PM
CHP - Monterey has lifted the Highway 1 closure.  The highway is fully reopened.
